def main():
    import sys
    import heapq
    
    def readints():
        return list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split()))
    
    n, k, x = readints()
    a = readints()
    
    # Create a min-heap based on the absolute values of the elements
    heap = [(abs(ai), i) for i, ai in enumerate(a)]
    heapq.heapify(heap)
    
    # Apply up to k operations
    for _ in range(k):
        abs_val, idx = heapq.heappop(heap)

            a[idx] -= x
        else:
            a[idx] += x

    print(*a)
